bio: Marie possesses that charm typical of the South of France. The brasserie decor exudes luxury, but the terrace overlooking the boats and bridges is where everyone wants a table. This tranquil oasis in the heart of the city is enhanced by the Mediterranean finesse of the cuisine. The lamb fillet and cheeks with a perfectly balanced hollandaise sauce, the salt-baked sea bass, the generous beef tartare: these are down-to-earth dishes that pack a punch, and they are simply irresistible. This is what Bib Gourmand is all about!...
